say:4:1220246002:1.text: We give up. Here, you can take these pipes.
say:4:1220246002:1.source_cn: 打不过，我们认栽，这些管子归你们了。

say:5:1220246003:1.text: Why would we need these pipes?

say:6:1220246004:1.text: Then... if you don't want the pipes, why'd you fight us?
say:6:1220246004:1.source_cn: 不抢水管，你们打我们干嘛？

say:7:1220246005:1.text: To make sure you don't mess with pipes anymore! Rustport's entire water supply depends on them!
say:7:1220246005:1.source_cn: 不许再破坏这些水管了！整个锈锚港的运水和净水系统，就靠...

say:8:1220246006:1.text: Don't you dare come back. If you do, I'll break your legs and toss you into the sea!
say:8:1220246006:1.source_cn: 要是再来，老子打断你们的腿，都丢进海里！

say:9:1220246007:1.text: We're sorry! But the water from these pipes is so pricy and tastes terrible. We don't even drink it anymore, so why do you even need the pipes?
say:9:1220246007:1.source_cn: 我们知错了。但这些水管流出来的水又贵，又不好喝，我们都...

say:12:1220246008:1.text: You fools won't understand. Just know that from now on, the water will taste better!
say:12:1220246008:1.source_cn: 和你们说不通，总之，你们只需要知道，从今以后水会变好喝...

say:13:1220246009:1.text: Yep! This is the Whispers' specialized craftsman. He's testing out the new water filter system. Once it's up and running, everyone in Rustport will have clean, tasty water!
say:13:1220246009:1.source_cn: 对，看见没，这位是索尼娅和卢卡委托的净水系统改造工匠，...

say:16:1220246010:1.text: Whether it's for cooking, drinking, or washing! You can use it for anything.
say:16:1220246010:1.source_cn: 是的，不管是喝，还是做饭，还是洗漱，都可以随便用！

say:17:1220246011:1.text: What? Stop daydreaming. Luck like that doesn't happen to people in Rustport!
say:17:1220246011:1.source_cn: 啊？你们说什么呢，别做梦了，哪有那种好事？

say:18:1220246012:1.text: Wow! You must still be drunk. Keep dreaming if you want! Just watch what we can do.
say:18:1220246012:1.source_cn: 嚯！看样子酒还没醒呢，是不是做梦就瞧着吧！

say:19:1220246013:1.text: Merlin, let's get this filtration device installed and wake these idiots up!
say:19:1220246013:1.source_cn: 梅林，我们先去把滤水装置装上，让这帮混蛋醒醒酒！
say:19:1220246013:1.male: Merlin, let's get this filtration device installed and wake these idiots up!
say:19:1220246013:1.female: Merlin, let's get this filtration device installed and wake these idiots up!
